admin.description:
If true, returns all projects. Otherwise, returns only the projects that the user has access to.
Note: The user must have the `get:all_projects` scope set in the JWT token, or an error will be returned.

filter.description:
filters the projects by a specific criteria

examples:
- `$.properties.type == "Normal"'` - filter by the project type
- `'$.description like_regex ".*Wield.*"'` - filter by the description
- `"$.user_properties.pinned == true"` - filter by the pinned status
- `'$.properties.type == "Inspection" && $.user_properties.pinned == false'` - filter by multiple criteria
- `'$.tags.name=="Inspection"'` - filter by the tag name

sort_criteria.description: list of sort criteria that are applied in order

path.description:
how to order the response

examples:
- `"$.created"` - sort by the created date
- `"$.user_properties.pinned"` - sort by the pinned status

ascending.description: sort in ascending order if true, descending otherwise

limit.description: limits the number of items on a page

offset.description: specifies how many items to skip

properties.description: list of properties associated with the project

user_properties.description: list of user defined properties associated with the project

tags.description: list of tags associated with the project

users.description:
list of users that have access to the project
this consolidates both project and workspace users
and acts as the effective rights

project_users.description: list of users that have access to the project as granted with project permissions

workspace_users.description: list of users that have access to the project as granted with workspaces permissions

storage.description: list of containers associated with the project

default_container_id.description: override the container ID used for the 'default' container
